items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1961-01-29
items.q: my father was a musician... What was his name? George Sayle.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. Did anybody in your family play instruments? I mean, where did you get the idea you wanted to play an instrument?
Well, my father was a musician. He played guitar and played viola, played a little bass. What was his name? George Sayle.
